'''Mummies''' are [[undead]] monsters found in the [[Jaldraocht Pyramid]] during [[Desert Treasure]]. The mummy spawns from [[Sarcophagus (Jaldraocht Pyramid)|sarcophagi]] when the player is standing nearby and shout {{RSChat|Rawr!}} when appearing. Mummies can only be killed using [[fire spells]] or [[fire arrows]].

The sarcophagi in the final altar room of the Jaldraocht Pyramid will not spawn mummies.
